description_en: Modifies the two-factor authentication settings of a bastion host
description_zh: 修改堡垒机实例的双因子配置
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost modify-instance-two-factor --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstanceTwoFactor

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the ID of the bastion host
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。

Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable two-factor authentication. Valid values:

true: yes

false: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启双因子。取值：

true：开启
false：不开启
parameters.name: enable_two_factor

parameters.help_en:
The method used to send a verification code for two-factor authentication. If EnableTwoFactor is set to true, you must specify at least one method. Valid values:

sms: text message.

email: email.

dingtalk: notice in DingTalk.

totp: one-time password (OTP) token.

gmusbkey: SM-based USB key
parameters.help_zh:
双因子验证码发送方式。当EnableTwoFactor为true时，至少要指定一种方式。取值：

sms：短信
email：邮箱
dingtalk：钉钉工作通知
totp：手机OTP令牌
gmusbkey：国密USBKEY
parameters.name: two_factor_methods

parameters.help_en: The duration within which two-factor authentication is not required after a user passes two-factor authentication. Valid values: 0 to 168. Unit: hours. If you set this parameter to 0, the user must pass two-factor authentication every time the user logs on to the bastion host
parameters.help_zh: 双因子认证成功后，后续登录堡垒机时跳过双因子认证的时间，取值范围为0~168，单位（小时）。0表示不跳过，每次都需要双因子认证
parameters.name: skip_two_factor_time

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
